images.filename: Hartfort CT Post Office and Customhouse, 1903.jpg
images.caption:
U.S. Post Office and Customhouse, Hartford, Conneticut (1903)
Completed in 1882.
Supervising Architect: Alfred B. Mullet
The U.S. District Court for the District of Connecticut met here until 1933; the U.S. Circuit Court for the District of Connecticut met here until that court was abolished in 1912. 

Razed in 1934.

images.filename: Frieze, Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Arch, Bushnell Park, Hartford, CT.jpg
images.caption: Frieze (south side), Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Arch, Bushnell Park, Hartford, Connecticut, USA. This is a composite image stitched together from a series of photographs. This frieze was created in 1885, and hence is no longer subject to any form of copyright restrictions. According to records in the Smithsonian Institute, the south frieze was carved by Caspar Buberl (1834-1899) which matches the signature on the frieze. Again, copyright has expired since he died more than 70 years ago.
images.alt: Frieze (south side), Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Arch, Bushnell Park, Hartford, Connecticut, USA. This is a composite image stitched together from a series of photographs.
